title: Degree of Fourier truncation
statement: For a natural number $n$, a natural number $k$, and a function $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, form the sum of the Fourier terms of $f$ indexed by subsets of size at most $k$. The resulting function has Fourier degree at most $k$.
